thread:
Samira: Heads-up — we need a short migration section for the v1->v2 embed swap. Users hitting the new model get 1536 dims instead of 768; search indexes break. PR opened? https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234
Jon: I saw the PR, it's a good start. Missing fallback pattern for live apps that can't reindex immediately.
Priya: Can we recommend an on-the-fly re-embed fallback: detect dims, if mismatch call v1 model and reindex async? Example snippet?
Jon: Yeah, recommend code like:
```
resp = client.embeddings.create(model="redwood-embed-v2", input=text)
if len(resp.embedding) != expected_dim:
    # fallback: call legacy model, queue reindex
    resp = client.embeddings.create(model="redwood-embed-v1", input=text)
    queue.reindex(item_id, resp.embedding)
```
Samira: Perfect. Include notes about cost tradeoffs and latency (v1 fallback adds ~100-300ms).
Kim: Also add a deprecation banner text for the console and a short blurb for the email to customers w/ reindexing options.
Priya: I'll add the deprecation copy to the PR and add a flag param example: `?embed_compat=true` to keep old dims for 30 days.
Samira: Make sure we include a test case in docs smoke tests: call embed endpoint, assert fallback path runs when dims mismatch.
DocBot: CI check: docs smoke tests need update — failing on example fixtures. https://ci.redwood/123/job/456
Jon: I'll update the fixtures in this PR. @deploy-bot please hold the banner rollout until we confirm the migration page is live.
deploy-bot: holding rollout for docs-banners until 4061240000. :white_check_mark:
Samira: Thanks — assigning owners: @Jon (code snippets + fixtures), @Priya (deprecation copy + email), @Kim (console banner). Let's merge after green CI and one doc-approver.
Priya: Adding reviewers now. small tweak: include migration checklist with commands to reindex (curl examples) and rate-limit notes.
Jon: Linking curl examples in PR.
Samira: Great. Targeting merge today after fixes. :rocket:
